name: LaunchDarkly
description: LaunchDarkly lets agents read, create, and update feature flags, segments, and AI configs in the signed-in LaunchDarkly account. Each user signs in through the browser; EU and Federal instances are not supported.

prompts.text: Which feature flags have not changed in 90 days and are safe to clean up?
Show the targeting rules of the new-checkout flag in production.
Create a boolean flag for the dark mode rollout, turned off in every environment.
